simulation_assumptions: AI probability/length filters, consultation gaps, timing-scale range and episode structure are provisional simulation settings, not measurements of AI behavior from CS1.
Empirical editing lengths and conditional gaps come only from the received calibration cache; no holdout is read.
Known AI-supplied contributions may arrive through insertion, acceptance, paste or simulated retyping. A raw event kind never determines its provenance label.
Typed edits of explicitly AI-supplied content are tagged by that content source; independent background edits in the same episode are tagged no_ai.
No physical keyboard, focus, run completion or outcome measurements are fabricated.
A window needs at least one non-reset edit affecting code with known provenance. No activity-count confidence threshold is applied; empty/run-only windows are insufficient.
Deletion provenance is inherited from the affected synthetic code. Touching the unknown artificial baseline makes that contribution uncertain.
This is an experimental first model, not a validated human/AI behavioral generator or deployment-ready classifier.
